archetypes.name: dyn-session-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Session cleanup now spans Step 0, Step 6, and PID-keyed residual files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 0 abort and Step 6 cleanup paths for correct residual reaping gates. Check that PID-keyed symlink, launcher, and parsed-env paths use the same home-cache helpers for write and cleanup. Pay special attention to failure and preservation paths that must leave residuals intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
